6441	export class AccessorOp extends Operator<AccessorOp> {
6442	  static displayName = 'Accessor'
6443	  static description =
6444	    'A function called for each row of your data and passed to Deck.gl layer properties. The current row is passed as the `d` variable (e.g., `d.population`, `d.properties.color`). Available variables: `d` (current row), `i` (index), `data` (all rows), `op()` (access operators), `sequenceTime` (timeline position), `frame` (current frame), `totalFrames`, `sequence` (timeline metadata). Includes d3, turf, and other utilities.'
6445	  createInputs() {
6446	    return {
6447	      expression: new ExpressionField(),
6448	    }
6449	  }
6450	  createOutputs() {
6451	    return {
6452	      accessor: new FunctionField(),
6453	    }
6454	  }
6455	  execute({ expression }: ExtractProps<typeof this.inputs>): ExtractProps<typeof this.outputs> {
6456	    const fn = fnWithSource(
6457	      [
6458	        'd',
6459	        'i',
6460	        'data',
6461	        'op',
6462	        'sequenceTime',
6463	        'frame',
6464	        'totalFrames',
6465	        'sequence',
6466	        ...Object.keys(freeExports),
6467	      ],
6468	      `return ${expression}`,
6469	      this.id
6470	    )
6471	
6472	    // Subscribe to timeline changes - accessor will get fresh values on each call
6473	    subscribeOpToTimeline(this)
6474	
6475	    // https://deck.gl/docs/developer-guide/using-layers#accessors
6476	    const accessor = (d: unknown, dInfo: { index: number; data: unknown; target: number[] }) => {
6477	      const contextualGetOp = safeOpGetter(this.id)
6478	      // Get fresh timeline values for each accessor call
6479	      const timelineContext = getTimelineContext()
6480	      try {
6481	        return fn(
6482	          d,
6483	          dInfo.index,
6484	          dInfo.data,
6485	          contextualGetOp,
6486	          timelineContext.sequenceTime,
6487	          timelineContext.frame,
6488	          timelineContext.totalFrames,
6489	          timelineContext.sequence,
6490	          ...Object.values(freeExports)
6491	        )
6492	      } catch (_e) {
6493	        // Swallow per-row errors — returning undefined lets deck.gl skip the item
6494	        // rather than crashing the GPU process
6495	        return undefined
6496	      }
6497	    }
6498	
6499	    return { accessor }
6500	  }

1	// Migration to remove MapStyleOp nodes and inline their value onto connected
2	// MaplibreBasemapOp inputs. The MapStyleOp was a pass-through node that only
3	// existed to expose a preset map style URL as a string output.
4	
5	import type { NoodlesProjectJSON } from '../utils/serialization'
6	
7	const CARTO_DARK = 'https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/gl/dark-matter-nolabels-gl-style/style.json'
8	
9	export async function up(project: NoodlesProjectJSON): Promise<NoodlesProjectJSON> {
10	  const mapStyleNodes = project.nodes.filter(n => n.type === 'MapStyleOp')
11	  if (mapStyleNodes.length === 0) return project
12	
13	  const mapStyleIds = new Set(mapStyleNodes.map(n => n.id))
14	
15	  // Build a map of mapStyleOpId -> the style URL value it held
16	  const styleValues = new Map<string, string>()
17	  for (const node of mapStyleNodes) {
18	    const val = (node.data?.inputs as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.mapStyle
19	    styleValues.set(node.id, typeof val === 'string' ? val : CARTO_DARK)
20	  }
21	
22	  // Find edges from MapStyleOp.out.mapStyle -> MaplibreBasemapOp.par.mapStyle
23	  // and record what value each target node should receive
24	  const targetValues = new Map<string, string>()
25	  for (const edge of project.edges) {
26	    if (mapStyleIds.has(edge.source) && edge.sourceHandle === 'out.mapStyle') {
27	      const styleUrl = styleValues.get(edge.source)
28	      if (styleUrl !== undefined) {
29	        targetValues.set(edge.target, styleUrl)
30	      }
31	    }
32	  }
33	
34	  // Apply values to target nodes and remove MapStyleOp nodes + their edges
35	  const nodes = project.nodes
36	    .filter(n => !mapStyleIds.has(n.id))
37	    .map(node => {
38	      const val = targetValues.get(node.id)
39	      if (val === undefined) return node
40	      return {
41	        ...node,
42	        data: {
43	          ...node.data,
44	          inputs: {
45	            ...(node.data?.inputs as Record<string, unknown> | undefined),
46	            mapStyle: val,
47	          },
48	        },
49	      }
50	    })
51	
52	  const edges = project.edges.filter(e => !mapStyleIds.has(e.source) && !mapStyleIds.has(e.target))
53	
54	  return { ...project, nodes, edges }
55	}
